from solution import count_no_of_ways


def test_issue_example_two_posts_four_colors():
    """At most 2 adjacent same: 2 posts and 4 colors allows 16 ways."""
    # 4*4 = 16
    assert count_no_of_ways(2, 4) == 16


def test_issue_one_post_four_colors():
    """At most 2 adjacent same: 1 post and 4 colors allows 4 ways."""
    # k = 4
    assert count_no_of_ways(1, 4) == 4


def test_issue_two_posts_three_colors():
    """At most 2 adjacent same: 2 posts and 3 colors allows 9 ways."""
    # 3*3 = 9
    assert count_no_of_ways(2, 3) == 9


def test_issue_two_posts_one_color():
    """At most 2 adjacent same: 2 posts and 1 color allows 1 way."""
    # 1*1 = 1
    assert count_no_of_ways(2, 1) == 1


def test_issue_three_posts_two_colors():
    """At most 2 adjacent same: 3 posts and 2 colors forbids 000 and 111."""
    # 2*2*2 - 2 = 6
    assert count_no_of_ways(3, 2) == 6


def test_issue_three_posts_three_colors():
    """At most 2 adjacent same: 3 posts and 3 colors forbids 3 all same."""
    # 3*3*3 - 3 = 24
    assert count_no_of_ways(3, 3) == 24


def test_issue_three_posts_four_colors():
    """At most 2 adjacent same: 3 posts and 4 colors forbids 4 all same."""
    # 4*4*4 - 4 = 60
    assert count_no_of_ways(3, 4) == 60


def test_issue_three_posts_one_color():
    """At most 2 adjacent same: 3 posts and 1 color allows 0 ways."""
    # only RRR, has 3 same, so 0
    assert count_no_of_ways(3, 1) == 0


def test_issue_four_posts_two_colors():
    """At most 2 adjacent same: 4 posts and 2 colors allows 10 ways."""
    # (4 + 6) * 1 = 10
    assert count_no_of_ways(4, 2) == 10


def test_issue_four_posts_three_colors():
    """At most 2 adjacent same: 4 posts and 3 colors allows 66 ways."""
    # (9 + 24) * 2 = 66
    assert count_no_of_ways(4, 3) == 66


def test_issue_five_posts_two_colors():
    """At most 2 adjacent same: 5 posts and 2 colors allows 16 ways."""
    # (6 + 10) * 1 = 16
    assert count_no_of_ways(5, 2) == 16


def test_contract_callable():
    """Public interface count_no_of_ways(n, k) must be callable."""
    assert callable(count_no_of_ways)


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Number of ways of painting the fence must be an integer."""
    assert isinstance(count_no_of_ways(2, 4), int)
